checksum_mismatch.on_the_name: There is no checksum_mismatch code in the catalog: contracts/domain/v1/error-codes.json declares 20 codes and it is not among them. The internal ChecksumMismatchError carries code = storage_integrity_error. The limit is about criterion 10's checksum FAILURE, not an error code.
checksum_mismatch.evidence_surface: All twelve operations expanded from the frozen openapi.json, following every $ref through components, into the complete set of input names each accepts: 13 distinct names across the whole surface, none digest-shaped (no sha, digest, checksum, hash, md5, etag, crc). The only digest in the system is computed by the server from the bytes it received.
checksum_mismatch.evidence_routers: Measured independently of the document: an extra multipart part named sha256 -> 422 validation_failed field=body constraint=additionalProperties; a part named content-sha256 -> the same; startRun with an extra 'sha256' JSON property -> 422 validation_failed.
checksum_mismatch.evidence_guard: Against live MinIO, green half first, every object purged by exact identity and every byte built in-process. Green: publish then read(verify=True) returns identical bytes. R1 a false declared digest at verify_temporary -> ChecksumMismatchError and the temporary object is gone. R2 a false declared size -> SizeMismatchError. R3 bytes replaced out of band at the SAME LENGTH under verbatim metadata -> inspect() still reports it sound, read(verify=True) raises ChecksumMismatchError with both digests. R4 the content-sha256 metadata stripped -> BlobMetadataInvalidError, validation_failed, NOT the integrity code.
checksum_mismatch.evidence_through_the_front_door: A document uploaded through uploadDocument had its canonical object replaced out of band with a same-length body under verbatim metadata. streamDocumentVersionContent then answered 422 storage_integrity_error; getDocumentVersion still answered 200 with the declared digest, which is a declaration and not the bytes. The bytes were restored and the same call returned 200 with the original 58978.
checksum_mismatch.what_changed_since_c0d7daf: The limit is narrower than it was. At c0d7daf the checksum failure was proved only at the storage layer; waves 11 and 12 make the same failure, arriving from outside the twelve, detected and refused by the read path an operator actually calls. Inducibility is unchanged: still none.
